The arrests and detention of the applicants occurred prior to a demonstration.
On 17 April 2011, the first applicant was arrested before a demonstration of opposition to the government.
At 9.55 a.m. on 24 May 2012, the second applicant was walking with his grandson when he was stopped by two plainclothes police officers.
The first applicant was charged with the administrative offence of minor hooliganism under Article 296 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.

The Binagadi District Court found the second applicant guilty of the administrative offence of failure to comply with a lawful request of a police officer under Article 310 of the Code of Administrative Offences of Azerbaijan.
In his appeal, the second applicant claimed that he had been arrested to prevent him from participating in the demonstration of 24 May 2012.
The Sabail District Court sentenced the first applicant to a fine in the amount of 50 Azerbaijani manats (approximately 50 euros at the material time).
The Binagadi District Court sentenced the second applicant to a fine of 20 Azerbaijani manats (approximately 20 euros at the material time).
